description: Globale Referenzhistogramme der IMS-Infraschall Breitband-Detektionslisten is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by download.bgr.de. This data set builds upon the broadband detection lists of the International Monitoring System (IMS)’s infrasound stations. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Global reference histograms of the IMS infrasound broadband detection lists" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include noise, geophysics, Infraschall, CTBT, IMS, International Monitoring System. The listing shows 1 download or service links in NETCDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
